The Problem

Reading about diversification does not diversify anything.

The September 2023 Helpful Content Update wiped out publishers who had poured everything into Google organic. Recovery timelines stretched 6-18 months. Some sites never recovered.

The frameworks on this site tell you what to build. If you run the operation solo, the honest constraint is time: the audit, the tracking, the rebalancing cadence. That is the part you can hire out.
